en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Hassan Bin Mahboub, from Abdullah Bin Sinan,

(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> regarding the man who died and upon him was a debt, so a guarantor took the responsibility to the creditors. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘If the creditors are happy, so it has freed the deceased from the responsibility’.
en.sarwar: 5. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Hassan ibn Mahbub from ‘Abd Allah ibn Sinan who has narrated the following:

“About the case of a man who dies with debts on him and a guarantor takes responsibility to pay the creditors, abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘If the creditors agree, the deceased becomes free from responsibility.”’
